data.cultural_impact: The name Konstanze has been famously used in the opera "The Abduction from the Seraglio" by Mozart, where it is given to the leading female character, Konstanze. This opera has been widely performed and loved for over two centuries, and has contributed to making the name Konstanze synonymous with strength, constancy, and perseverance. Additionally, Konstanze has been the name of several royal figures, including two queens of Hungary, influencing its prestigious connotations.
